# ML-09: Time-Series Machine Learning (Tier 3)

**Subtrack:** Machine Learning Engineering  
**Unit scope:** Lag features, leakage-free temporal validation, global models, sequence models and anomaly detection on streams.

**Tier note:** Tier 1 has a single assessment because foundational time-series reasoning is covered in DS-10. The ML unit concentrates on modelling at Tiers 2 and 3.

- **[ML-T3-017](ML-T3-017-after-the-devaluation/README.md): After the Devaluation: Calibrated Price Forecasts Across a Structural Break.** Forecast a weekly staple-food price series through a synthetic currency shock: detect the break, decide how much history to trust, build calibrated 13-week prediction intervals, and argue the policy for the weeks right after a shock when almost no post-break data exists.
